description: Main API module for the notes management system, defining REST endpoints for creating, reading, updating, and deleting notes using FastAPI.

methods.name: health_check()
methods.description: Returns a simple health message to confirm the service is running.

methods.name: list_notes_endpoint(search: Optional[str] = Query(None, description="Search string to filter by title or content"))
methods.description: Lists all notes, optionally filtered by a search string.

methods.name: get_note_endpoint(note_id: int = Path(..., description="ID of the note to retrieve"))
methods.description: Retrieves a single note by its ID.

methods.name: update_note_endpoint( payload: NoteUpdate, note_id: int = Path(..., description="ID of the note to update"), )
methods.description: Updates fields of an existing note identified by ID.

methods.name: delete_note_endpoint(note_id: int = Path(..., description="ID of the note to delete"))
methods.description: Deletes a note by its ID.

ctags.name: delete_note_endpoint
ctags.pattern: /^def delete_note_endpoint(note_id: int = Path(..., description="ID of the note to delete")):$/
ctags.signature: (note_id: int = Path(..., description="ID of the note to delete"))

ctags.name: get_note_endpoint
ctags.pattern: /^def get_note_endpoint(note_id: int = Path(..., description="ID of the note to retrieve")):$/
ctags.signature: (note_id: int = Path(..., description="ID of the note to retrieve"))

ctags.name: list_notes_endpoint
ctags.pattern: /^def list_notes_endpoint(search: Optional[str] = Query(None, description="Search string to filter/
ctags.signature: (search: Optional[str] = Query(None, description="Search string to filter by title or content"))

ctags.name: update_note_endpoint
ctags.signature: ( payload: NoteUpdate, note_id: int = Path(..., description="ID of the note to update"), )
